backlogged.summary: expandFileGlob uses fs.globSync. It exists from Node 22.0 but is experimental there, so on Node 22/23 every --files run prints an ExperimentalWarning to stderr. It is harmless, but it is noise in stress output.

AC-2 passes without any change to the F23/F25/F26/F28 test files. The diff only adds the --files option, so the contract's title ('F23·F25·F26·F28 테스트' stability) is met only because those tests are already stable at 3x load on this machine. Nothing hardens them against slower machines.
A trailing `--files` with no value is pushed into the positional list and produces the generic usage error rather than a message saying --files needs a glob. The same is true of `--root`.

expandFileGlob is placed in lib/glob.mjs, a runtime module, even though only the test script test/stress.mjs uses it. Its semantics (character classes, case-sensitive file-system matching) also differ from globToRegExp in the same file, which could confuse future callers.
